neighbours.label: The opinion verb ' think' / ' thinks' / ' thought' with a subject who holds the view and a clause after it; quiet on other reporting and knowing verbs (know, guess, suppose, say, argue) and on 'thought' as a noun
fire: Write to us if you think the bill is wrong.
Our coach thinks the team can win the league.
For years she thought the house was haunted.
Many parents think the school day is too short.
The mechanic thinks the brakes are worn out.
As a child I thought the moon followed our car.
Do you think the bridge will open on time?
Nobody thought the old dog would live so long.
quiet: Write to us if you know the bill is wrong.
Our coach says the team can win the league.
For years she hoped the house would sell.
Many parents argue the school day is too short.
The mechanic says the brakes are worn out.
As a child I guessed the moon was made of rock.
Do you suppose the bridge will open on time?
It was a sad thought for such a sunny morning.

notes: Card: 31 of the top 32 peaks are think/thinks/thought (1 believe). Probes: 'if you think' 0.55, 'thinks' 0.55, 'thought' 0.43; know 0.01, guess 0.01, suppose 0.00, says 0.04, argue 0.00, noun 'thought' 0.11. 'believe' fired 0.34 and 'feel' 0.25, so the pole is wider than the word: those two are left out of the near misses, and the label is tested at the word level only.
